133f602007401ecd42efe5a982edcf4154100157.name: rosterQuery
133f602007401ecd42efe5a982edcf4154100157.body:
query rosterQuery($mnumber: String!, $term: String!, $year: Int!, $subject: String!, $number: Int!, $suffix: String, $section: String) {
  facultySingle(where: {mnumber: {eq: $mnumber}}) {
    courses_taught(
      startTerm: $term
      startYear: $year
      endTerm: $term
      endYear: $year
      subject: $subject
      number: $number
      suffix: $suffix
      section: $section
    ) {
      course {
        title
        __typename
      }
      course_subject
      course_number
      course_suffix
      course_section
      credit_hour
      total_students
      total_credit_hours
      class_gpa
      midterm_average
      final_average
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
